role.altitude: Family counseling, program judgements, and custody opinions stay with the marriage and family therapist. Draft wording for a session note, an education outline, and a factual evaluation takes less typing. Decision rights do not move.
reach: Substance Abuse and Behavioral Disorder Counselors: observe one group session and learn which relapse signs a family session should ask about, without scoring them.
Child, Family, and School Social Workers: read a school observation before a custody interview so the evaluation does not repeat that visit.
skills_to_grow: Comparing a drafted session note with what each family member said.
Writing a custody opinion only after the factual narrative has been checked.
Keeping session dates as stored fields so a completion total is arithmetic.
role.ambitious_version: The week still holds the family sessions, the education talks, the effectiveness judgement, and any court testimony. Drafts stop at one accepted note, one accepted outline, and one accepted evaluation. No new clinical service.

tasks.short: Counsel inmate families inside a substance abuse program.

steps.what: Open the case for inmates in substance abuse programs
Read which inmates are participating in family counseling
Read earlier family treatment notes before counseling
Give family counseling to inmates in substance abuse programs
Draft treatment notes from the family counseling

loop.input: The spoken family session and the earlier treatment notes.
loop.output: Wording of a session note. Not a diagnosis, a relapse score, or a risk category.
loop.check: The note has a session heading and one line quoted from the spoken family session. A sentence about harm must be the same sentence as in that session. The check does not judge the counseling.
loop.stop: The draft is written. The loop does not wait for the therapist. If the family session was not recorded, the loop does not run.
loop.why_not_simpler: The note is free text about what several people said. The case record has no fields for that conversation.

steps.what: Check treatment meaning against the spoken counseling
Commit the accepted note on the substance abuse counseling

tasks.design: A bounded loop on the {OTHER} case record drafts the family session note from the recorded counseling and the earlier treatment notes. The marriage and family therapist checks that wording against what was said, then commits that accepted version. The counseling stays in the room, and no relapse score is computed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The session note is free text about what several family members said, and the case record has no fields for that conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded loop can draft wording from a recording and quoted lines. The therapist still checks the meaning before the note is committed.
tasks.still_hard: A prison may refuse recording, the counseling stays human, and a wrong line about harm would matter.
tasks.human_edge: Only the therapist can judge what the family meeting meant and whether someone is at risk. The draft does not.
tasks.altitude: The family session stays the week. The therapist gains a note draft to accept or reject, and still decides what the meeting meant.

reach.role: Substance Abuse and Behavioral Disorder Counselors
reach.task: Counsel a group in the same substance abuse program.
reach.learn: Which signs the family session should ask about, without turning them into a score.

evidence.claim: Dictation in the care record can turn spoken notes into a report or a letter, including in mental-health care. That supports a wording draft of a session note from a recorded conversation. It does not provide the family counseling. No time figure is taken.

A review of transcription tools in social work found invented content in notes, including invented suicidal ideation. One council's own check was less positive than the vendor evaluation. No time figure is taken.
Health data is a special category under GDPR article 9.
GDPR article 22 restricts decisions based solely on automated processing.
EU AI Act annex III covers systems that assess the risk of re-offending.
Recording staff conversations needs works council consent under the works-councils act, article 27.
An inspection found that a probation risk formula had placed cases in the wrong category and the use was paused.
A family session note is free text. A stored form does not hold what each person said. A model must not score harm or relapse. Model knowledge.

assumptions: Largest remainder on the means prior gives screens 4, spreadsheets 1, mail 3, documents 21, meetings 71. The one-point spreadsheet prior is folded into documents, which become 22, because this task has no separate tally. That is a design split, not a measured study.

Document time is split into reading earlier treatment notes (8), drafting the session note (8), checking it (4), and committing it (2). The case screen, the prison message, and the counseling keep their shares and stay at remaining 100.

Producer of the open case and the earlier notes is the read of the case record. Producer of the spoken session is the counseling itself. If the session was not recorded, the draft is skipped and the therapist writes the note by hand inside the check.

The machine draft is not gated. Its loop stops when the draft is written and does not wait for the therapist. The check names accepted family session note v1. The commit stores that version and does not edit it. A later edit voids the check.

The counseling is not a record commit. No relapse score and no re-offending category are computed. Focal incremental hours are zero because the therapist already writes and already checks the note. The incremental entry is system time to keep the note heading available. Existing case-record runtime earns no labour saving.
unknowns: Whether the prison allows a recording of the family session.
Whether the works council must consent before a recording that includes the therapist.
Whether the case record already has a place for a family session note.
research_questions: How often is this family session recorded today, and how often is the note written from memory?
Who employs the therapist for the prison program: the clinic, or the institution?

already_counted.description: The therapist still compares the draft with what the family said. Those hours sit in the check.

incremental.description: Keeping the session-note heading available in the case record module.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the prison does not allow a recording, the therapist writes the note by hand and the saving is zero. If only part of the family meeting is recorded, some typing of the note is avoided and the check stays full time. The counseling itself is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach professionals about counseling services and methods.

steps.what: Open the clinic pages on counseling services and methods
Read the method notes the education outline will use
Read the request from professionals and their groups
Draft an education outline on counseling methods for groups

loop.input: The method notes and the host's request.
loop.output: Outline wording about methods. No client story and no treatment advice for a named person.
loop.check: Each outline section names a heading that exists in the method notes, and no client name is present. The check does not decide what the group should hear.
loop.stop: The draft is written. The loop does not wait for the therapist. If no method note is stored as text, the loop does not run.
loop.why_not_simpler: The outline is prose for one group's question. A stored form has no place for that explanation.

steps.what: Check the outline against the counseling methods
Send the accepted education outline to the groups
Give public education and consultation to professionals in groups

tasks.design: A bounded loop drafts an education outline from method notes in {DOCS} and the host's question in {EMAIL}. The marriage and family therapist checks that the outline stays on methods and contains no client story, then sends that accepted version. The talk with the group stays in person and does not edit the outline.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each group's question is different, and the outline is prose rather than fields in a stored form.
tasks.enabler_now: The clinic already keeps method notes, so a loop can draft from those notes and the host's question.
tasks.still_hard: The talk is live, and a public outline must not carry a client's health data.
tasks.human_edge: Only the therapist can decide what this group should hear, and can say it in the room.
tasks.altitude: The talk stays the week. The therapist gains an outline draft to accept or reject, and still decides what to say to the group.

reach.task: Lead a public session on a health topic for a non-clinical group.
reach.learn: How they structure a session so the outline stays on methods and leaves the examples to the speaker.

evidence.claim: An education outline can be drafted from the therapist's own method notes and the host's question. The therapist still decides what to say in the room. Model knowledge.
Health data is a special category under GDPR article 9.

assumptions: The means prior sums to 99.9, so it is scaled by 100/99.9 before largest remainder. That gives screens 2, spreadsheets 0, mail 6, documents 15, meetings 77. There is no spreadsheet step.

Document time is split into reading method notes (4), drafting the outline (6), and checking it (5). Mail is split into reading the request (4) and sending the accepted outline (2). The talk keeps 77 and stays at remaining 100.

Producer of the quotable method text is the read of the method notes. Producer of the group's question is the host's message. If the method notes are not stored as text, the draft is skipped and the therapist speaks from memory.

The machine draft is not gated. Its loop stops when the draft is written and does not wait for the therapist. The check names accepted education outline v1. The send uses that version and does not edit it. The live talk does not edit it. A later edit voids the check.

No client health data is copied into the outline. Focal incremental hours are zero because the therapist already prepares and already checks a talk. The incremental entry is system time to keep method-note headings current. Existing document-store runtime earns no labour saving.
unknowns: Whether hosts expect a written outline before the session, or only the talk.
Whether the method notes in the document store are free of client names.
research_questions: Which groups ask for these sessions, and do they want a written outline?

already_counted.description: The therapist still checks that the outline matches the method notes and the host's question. Those hours sit in the check.

incremental.description: Keeping method-note headings current in the document store so the outline can quote them.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When the host wants only a live conversation, there is no outline to draft and the saving is zero. When the talk repeats stored method notes, some outline typing is avoided and the therapist still rewrites the examples in the check. The talk stays full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Judge counseling program results from clients' adjustments.

steps.what: Open session dates and notes for counseling programs
Read results and clients' adjustments in the notes
Total completed sessions in these counseling programs
Read questions about results of counseling programs
Ask clients about adjustments after counseling programs
Determine effectiveness from clients' adjustments and results
Commit the accepted effectiveness finding to the record

tasks.design: Code on the {OTHER} case record totals completed sessions from stored dates, replacing the tally now kept in the {SPREADSHEET}. The marriage and family therapist still reads the notes, still talks with clients, and still determines effectiveness, then commits that finding. The total is not an effectiveness judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Session dates sit in the case record while the completion tally is kept separately, and effectiveness is a judgement about people.
tasks.enabler_now: If the dates are stored as fields, code can total them. The judgement of whether the program helped stays with the therapist.
tasks.still_hard: Many notes have no completion field, and a count does not show whether a client is better.
tasks.human_edge: Only the therapist can judge whether the program helped these clients. A completion count cannot.
tasks.altitude: The follow-up talks and the effectiveness judgement stay the week. The therapist no longer retypes a completion tally, and still decides whether the program helped.

reach.role: Mental Health and Substance Abuse Social Workers
reach.task: Monitor a client's progress after a program ends.
reach.learn: Which adjustment the client names in their own words before the effectiveness finding is written.

evidence.claim: Totaling stored session dates is arithmetic. Naming whether a program helped is not. Model knowledge.
Health data is a special category under GDPR article 9.
GDPR article 22 restricts decisions based solely on automated processing.
An inspection found that a probation risk formula had placed cases in the wrong category and the use was paused.

assumptions: The means prior sums to 100.1, so it is scaled by 100/100.1 before largest remainder. That gives screens 8, spreadsheets 7, mail 6, documents 31, meetings 48. The spreadsheet share is this task's completion tally, not a device reused from another task.

Document time is split into reading adjustment notes (16), determining effectiveness (10), and committing the finding (5). The case screen, the tally, the program lead's message, and the client talks keep their shares. Only the tally goes to remaining 0.

Producer of the stored session dates is the open of the case record. If those dates are not stored as fields, the total is skipped and the therapist counts by hand while reading the notes. That hand count is not a new baseline.

The completion count is not gated because it is arithmetic and it is not the finding. The therapist writes accepted effectiveness finding v1 in the decision step. The commit stores that version and does not edit it. A later edit voids the check. The count is not turned into a risk category.

The client talk is not a record commit. Focal incremental hours are zero because the therapist already reads notes and already judges effectiveness. The incremental entry is system time to keep session dates stored as fields. Existing case-record runtime earns no labour saving.
unknowns: Whether session dates are stored as fields, or only inside note prose.
Whether the effectiveness question comes from a colleague or from an outside funder.
research_questions: Are completion dates already fields in the case record for these counseling programs?

incremental.description: Keeping session dates stored as fields the completion total can read.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If session dates are only inside note prose, the therapist still counts by hand and the saving is zero. If the dates are stored fields, the tally is computed and the reading, the client talks, and the effectiveness decision stay full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write parent and child evaluations for custody courts.

steps.what: Open the court referral on the parents and children
Read the courts' questions on divorce and custody cases
Read court papers about the parents and children
Interview parents and children for the custody evaluations
Draft evaluations of parents and children from the interviews

loop.input: The parent interviews, the child interviews, and the court papers.
loop.output: A factual narrative. Not a custody arrangement and not a diagnosis.
loop.check: Each factual paragraph contains a line quoted from an interview or from the court papers. The check does not state who should have custody.
loop.stop: The draft is written. The loop does not wait for the therapist. If the interviews were not recorded, the loop does not run.
loop.why_not_simpler: The narrative joins several speakers and the court papers into prose. A stored form cannot hold that narrative, and the custody opinion is not drafted here.

steps.what: Check facts and write the custody opinion for courts
Commit the accepted custody evaluation for the courts
Send the accepted custody evaluation to the courts
Attend court for testifying on the custody cases

tasks.design: A bounded loop on the {OTHER} case record drafts the factual narrative from the interviews and the court papers in {DOCS}. The marriage and family therapist checks those facts, writes the custody opinion, commits that version, and may send it to the court by {EMAIL}. Testimony stays spoken and does not edit the text.
tasks.previous_blocker: The evaluation joins several interviews and court papers into prose, and the custody opinion is the therapist's.
tasks.enabler_now: A loop can draft the factual narrative from quoted interviews. The opinion is written only when the therapist checks the facts.
tasks.still_hard: A court may forbid recording, an invented fact would harm a child, and testimony cannot be drafted.
tasks.human_edge: Only the therapist can form the custody opinion and can testify to it.
tasks.altitude: The interviews and any testimony stay the week. The therapist gains a factual draft to correct, and still writes the custody opinion.

reach.role: Child, Family, and School Social Workers
reach.task: Write about a child's circumstances for a decision made outside the clinic.
reach.learn: Which school observation is already recorded so the custody interview does not repeat it.

evidence.claim: A factual narrative can be drafted from the therapist's own interview notes and the court papers. The custody opinion is still the therapist's. Model knowledge.

A review of transcription tools in social work found invented content in notes, including invented suicidal ideation. One council's own check was less positive than the vendor evaluation. No time figure is taken.
Health data is a special category under GDPR article 9.
GDPR article 22 restricts decisions based solely on automated processing.
Under the treatment-agreement rules, a treatment dossier is kept for 20 years.

assumptions: The means prior sums to 99.9, so it is scaled by 100/99.9 before largest remainder. That gives screens 5, spreadsheets 1, mail 5, documents 47, meetings 42. The one-point spreadsheet prior is folded into documents, which become 48, because this task has no tally.

Meetings are split into the parent and child interviews (32) and testimony (10). Documents are split into reading court papers (12), drafting the factual narrative (14), checking facts and writing the custody opinion (14), and committing the evaluation (8). Mail is split into reading the court's questions (3) and sending the evaluation (2). Interviews, testimony, reading, the check, the commit, and the send stay at remaining 100.

Producer of the court papers is the read of those papers. Producer of the interviews is the interview step. If the interviews were not recorded, the draft is skipped and the therapist writes the narrative by hand inside the check.

The machine draft is not gated and does not state a custody arrangement. Its loop stops when the draft is written and does not wait for the therapist. The check adds the custody opinion and names accepted custody evaluation v1. The commit and the send use that version and do not edit it. Testimony does not edit it. A later edit voids the check.

Whether the 20-year treatment-dossier term applies to a court evaluation is unknown. Focal incremental hours are zero because the therapist already writes the evaluation and already checks it. The incremental entry is system time to keep evaluation headings available. Existing case-record runtime earns no labour saving.
unknowns: Whether the court allows a recording of the parent and child interviews.
Whether this evaluation is kept as a treatment dossier, or only sent to the court.
Which lawful basis covers sending this health data to the court.
research_questions: Does this therapist testify on most evaluations, or only when the court calls?
Which headings does the court require in the evaluation?

already_counted.description: The therapist still checks every factual line and still writes the custody opinion. Those hours sit in the check.

incremental.description: Keeping the evaluation headings available in the case record module.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the court forbids recording, the therapist writes the whole evaluation by hand and the saving is zero. If the interviews are recorded, some factual narrative is drafted and the therapist still writes the custody opinion in full during the check. Interviews and testimony stay full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
